info.name: Task Processing Utility
info.summary: Auto-scales Task Processing workers based on the queue
info.description:
A persistent supervisor service that scales the number of Task Processing PHP workers up and down between an admin-configurable minimum and maximum, based on the size of the Task Processing queue. Each task type is scheduled fairly so that a flood of one task type cannot starve the others.
The supervisor is a single static binary (written in Go) that reads the task queue directly from the Nextcloud database and spawns long-lived PHP workers, each pinned to one task type and recycled periodically to pick up config changes.
info.author: Nextcloud contributors
